correctness.rationale: From ω=2 Sinkhorn ratio updates U+=g_c(V)^2/U and V+=g_c(U+)^2/V, where g_c(t)=(ct+1)/(t+c). Both maps are global involutions, determinant -1 in log-odds; composition determinant +1. The rational first integral J=(UV+c(U+V)+1)/sqrt(UV) is invariant because the first reflection exchanges the numerator summands after writing J linear in sqrt(U), and likewise for V. In log coordinates J=2cosh((X+Y)/2)+2c cosh((X-Y)/2) has positive-definite Hessian (det=c cosh((X+Y)/2)cosh((X-Y)/2)>0), proper compact strictly convex level ovals and unique minimum at origin. |φ_c'(y)|≤|1-c|/(1+c)<1 excludes other fixed points. Exact preservation of area and H forces commutation with the nonzero Hamiltonian field; on every oval this is a rigid time shift, so periodic or dense, recurrent and never convergent to origin. Independent symbolic checks verified both involution invariants and Hessian determinant for arbitrary positive symbols; c=1 degeneracy remains a valid half-turn map.
